name: SeatMapCapacity
job: Show how full an event, class or tour is as a small seating plan where taken seats are filled and remaining ones glow, with "12 seats left" called out
visitor_action: hover or tap a seat for its row label; arrow keys move between seats when the plan is focused; none required
owner_settings: Seat layout style (theatre, round tables, benches)
Call-out text (with the number of seats left) and sold-out text
Labels for available, taken, row, table and seat
mobile: plan scales to the container width; narrow containers use a tighter fan and larger seats, round tables wrap to at most 3 per row
motion: taken seats pop in sequence (best seats first) with a soft spring, free brass seats breathe twice then settle, all under 5s and only once visible (reduced-motion: static fill)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: round-tables layout was oversized and clipped; narrow fan tightened)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass on table spacing)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Velvet stalls: oxblood and plum seats on warm cream plan paper, brass-gold available seats (restyled: flat seats with a soft brass glow instead of per-seat inner shadows)
notes: Which seats are taken is generated (best seats fill first), not owner-chosen; at 375px with 300+ seats the seats get small (~8px), and 'fewer rows shown' on mobile is interpreted as a tighter, bigger-seat layout rather than hiding rows.
